summary: Instagram for a brand is set up the way Meta needs it: a professional account linked to the brand's Facebook Page in the business portfolio. Connect never saves a different account than the profile's own (Meta offering only @softwings25 for @massagewithmia is now refused with what to do). The Instagram row shows its setup steps, explained, until it is connected to its own account: make the Page in the business portfolio's Pages settings and create or log into the Instagram profile from that Page (Connect assets), and switch an existing account to professional in the brand's own window, never the shared one.
